comment: Reviewed save migrations. Each entry names a saved field the candidate may rewrite, and why. Nothing here may be inferred from a failing run alone; every rule cites the decision or gotcha that makes the change intended.

herbalwitch:stations/drying_rack/station.why: ProcessJob reads schema 1 (0.1.0-0.5.0) and writes schema 2 (0.6.0, M7 witch recipes); recipe, fingerprint, reservation and progress carry over (docs/GOTCHAS.md 'An unknown job schema is preserved')

herbalwitch:decor/storage.why: The small wall shelf had no block entity before 0.4.0; it gains an empty one on first access and its modelled bottles never become items (docs/GOTCHAS.md 'Old small shelves have no block entity')

herbalwitch:decor/openings/door.why: The Evil Eye pack world carries waterlogged=false on every door from a foreign mod that adds the property to DoorBlock; Herbal Witch never declared it (its 0.6.1 door blockstates have no waterlogged variant), so the candidate reads the door without it. Only a false value is a lossless drop; compare refuses waterlogged=true.
